short:
Love & Light Palms is a holistic wellness practice based in Columbus, Ohio, offering Usui Reiki Healing, Chakra Balancing, Aura Cleansing, and Akashic Records Readings. Services focus on relaxation, energetic balance, personal reflection, and overall well-being.

In-person Reiki experiences are available in Columbus, with distance Reiki offered to clients regardless of location. Each experience is designed to provide a peaceful, compassionate, and welcoming environment.
certs: Usui Shiki Ryoho Reiki — First Degree (Level I), October 26, 2025; Advanced Degree (Level II), March 29, 2026. Both awarded by The Reiki Center for Healing Arts, Columbus, Ohio.
training: Trained in Usui Shiki Ryoho Reiki at The Reiki Center for Healing Arts, 1540 West Fifth Avenue, Columbus, Ohio, under Linda Haley, RMT, Executive Director. Completed First Degree training on October 26, 2025, and Advanced Degree training on March 29, 2026. Training hours are not specified on the certificates.
pricing: Complimentary 20-minute first-time Reiki experience available by appointment, in person or at a distance. Reiki Healing: 30-minute in-person sessions starting at $45; 60-minute in-person sessions $80. Distance Reiki sessions and additional holistic wellness services are available. Pricing varies by service and duration. Visit www.loveandlightpalms.com or our Vagaro booking page for current service options and pricing.
long:
Welcome to Love & Light Palms, where Healing Begins Within.

Founded by Charla Woods-Favors, a Usui Reiki Level II practitioner, Love & Light Palms provides compassionate, personalized holistic wellness experiences in Columbus, Ohio, and remotely.

Services include Reiki Healing, Chakra Balancing, Aura Cleansing, and Akashic Records Readings. Our approach encourages relaxation, energetic balance, self-awareness, and personal growth in a peaceful, judgment-free environment.

We offer a complimentary 20-minute first-time experience by appointment, allowing newcomers to discover Reiki in a welcoming and comfortable setting.

Whether you're seeking a moment of stillness or exploring a deeper connection with yourself, you are welcome here.

You Matter. You Belong Here.

Visit www.loveandlightpalms.com to explore our services and schedule an experience.
size: A growing independent practice, initially serving approximately 5–10 clients weekly
